race.description: 2026 Qbred Triad Final - 3yo Colts & Geldings Pace (G1)
race.comment: FIRE AND PASSION (6) is looking for Group One success after taking out a much weaker race at his latest appearance over 2138m at this track, scoring by 10 metres. Sure to prove hard to beat. IDEAL BRONSKI (11) lines up for the hat-trick after taking out a much weaker event over 2138m at this track last time out, getting home by 5 metres. Another big performance is on the cards. PURE GRUNT (1) was an impressive winner last start over 2138m at this track, getting home by 6 metres. Drawn well so another win will not surprise. JAMES ALFRED (2) comes here fresh from a second eight days ago over 2138m at this track, beaten 5 metres. Drawn well so he is a great chance to take this out.
